description: Equitable Holdings is a financial services company with six distinct offerings: individual retirement, group retirement, asset management, protection solutions, wealth management, and legacy. Through these segments, both individuals and organizations can access retirement plans and asset management services. Other offerings across the segments include life insurance policies and employee benefit packages. The company started in 1859 and now has approximately 12,000 employees and financial professionals.

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in New York
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"When I first came to this company, it felt very welcoming and I had a lot of people who helped me grow as a person and as a developer here at Equitable. Ever since then, I have made so many new connections with different people and all of them are all super nice, genuine people. What makes this place unique and a great place to work is the great management, the people, as well as the work-life balance—its insane, the amount of PTO you get. "

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in New York
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Individuals respect and care for one another which highly contributes to productivity and success. Everyone takes their work very seriously (with a sense of humor as well) and are dedicated to providing a quality end result/product. To be honest—I feel that the culture is very unique for insurance, in a positive way, and is a testament to those that have shaped the organization."
